title: Suno launches v6 music models trained on licensed Warner, BMG and Believe catalogs
summary: Suno has rolled out its v6 generation of AI music models, built in partnership with Warner Music Group, BMG and Believe, with revenue-sharing arrangements for participating rightsholders. The release introduces a flagship v6 model, a 'less predictable' v6-wild, and a free v6-mini tier, alongside new editing, isolation and mashup features aimed at professional music workflows. Suno says it will retire its previous models as v6 deploys.
